title: R03 Controlled Field Evaluation of Narrative Audio Conditioning (Conditions A vs B)
hypothesis: Condition A (Narrative Audio) increases actual next workout start rate (within TBD) compared to Condition B (Component Test) without increasing route abort rates.

A.name: Condition A (Narrative Audio)
A.description: Full narrative story overlay bound to spatial POI anchors and C25K workout transitions

B.name: Condition B (Component Test / Non-narrative Control)
B.description: Component test preserving narrative structure while altering place dramatic function (identical workout cues, route timing, and audio voice as Condition A, but using a non-dramatic place function with neutral environmental framing without spatial POI dramatic triggers)

primary_outcomes.name: Actual Next Workout Started Within TBD (Binary 0/1)

exclusion_criteria.reason: Run was aborted before completion or audio ended prematurely
Immediate debrief recording delay > 3600 seconds (confound_delayed_debrief == true)
Missing required immediate or recall fields
